fields.System.Title: FDN-803 — Retry with backoff
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want failed deliveries retried with increasing delays, so that a
temporary consumer outage resolves itself without anyone intervening.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a delivery fails, then the attempt count increases and the next attempt is
  • scheduled after a growing delay.
  • - Given the consumer recovers, then queued events are delivered in order.
  • - Given an event, then its attempt count and last error are visible for diagnosis.
  • - Given a consumer down for an hour, then no events are lost and warehouse operations
  • are unaffected.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform |
| Tables | outbox |
| Risks | Tight retry loops hammering a struggling consumer |
| Tests | integration |
